title: Mobile pending replay may retain requests after worker exit without refreshing worker state
directEvidence: PendingMobileApprovals clears on setWorkerState dead/newgen but replayLines alone is state-independent.
Main outbound subscription refreshes worker state only when a line arrives; native pending IPC and Pet decision read also refresh.
Mobile session.select/sync call orchestrator replay directly, whose current read does not refresh worker state.
Bridge onExit shown callback handles snapshots and renderer lifecycle; getSnapshot is local and does not start/sample worker.
unresolved: Whether other always-running lifecycle/Pet callbacks necessarily clear the cache before an ordinary mobile replay.
Whether actual externalCommands/output-recovery selection or client generation handling prevents stale requests becoming visible.
Full generation/exit event production and old cause history need independent verification.
notClaimed: No authority bypass or successful stale approval execution claimed.
No real worker crash, phone, renderer, model or file/clock experiment.
No current formal count; do not report missing setWorkerState call alone as proven lifecycle bug.
